title: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
abstract: arXiv:2611.02472v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A GUI command can be correct at the interface level yet still produce an incorrect assembly. An agent must identify the relevant components, respect their structural relationships, and determine which parts should move during recovery. We introduce MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families that separates Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework. For rework, the objective counts distinct moved parts within the validated recovery candidate set for each state, rather than the number of actions. We also introduce MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen policy obtained by supervised fine-tuning. Its key design matches correction granularity to output dependencies. Structured candidates revise assembly fields and rework scope, while complete action candidates keep native GUI primitives coupled with their parameters. translated_title: MAGAR：面向基于GUI的3D机械装配与最小返工的多模态智能体
translated_abstract: 一个GUI命令在界面层面可能正确，却仍会产生错误的装配。智能体必须识别相关组件、遵循它们的结构关系，并确定在恢复过程中哪些部件应当移动。我们提出MAGAR-Bench，一个包含来自26个装配族的4,000个多模态样本的基准，它将装配决策、原子操作与最小返工分离开来。在返工方面，目标函数统计的是每个状态下已验证恢复候选集中被移动的不同部件数量，而非操作次数。我们还提出了MAGAR，一个建立在通过监督微调获得的冻结策略之上的选择性纠正框架。其关键设计是将纠正粒度与输出依赖关系相匹配：结构化候选用于修订装配字段与返工范围，而完整操作候选则保持原生GUI原语与其参数的耦合。学习到的选择器会保留原始预测，除非……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出MAGAR-Bench基准（涵盖26个装配族的4,000个多模态样本，将装配决策、原子操作与最小返工分离）以及基于冻结策略的选择性纠正框架MAGAR，通过匹配纠正粒度与输出依赖关系，实现基于GUI的3D机械装配的最小返工。
en_tdlr: Proposes MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families separating Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework, along with MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen fine-tuned policy that matches correction granularity to output dependencies for GUI-based 3D mechanical assembly with minimal rework.
